title: Normalization of a one-dimensional semilocal domain is Dedekind
statement: Let B be a semilocal Noetherian domain of Krull dimension 1 [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] [def-weil-pbc-krull-dimension-ring], let K be its fraction field, and let B' be the integral closure of B in K [def-weil-pbc-integral-closure]. Then B' is a semilocal Dedekind domain (a Noetherian integrally closed domain of Krull dimension 1 [def-weil-pbc-normal-ring]) and its fraction field is K.

source.place: Algebra Lemma 09N2 proof, invoking Algebra Lemma 034X (integral-closure-Dedekind)

proof.text: Set F = FractionRing B, in the same universe as B. Apply [lem-sc-integral-closure-dedekind-surjective-fibres] with fraction field and extension field both F. It gives that C = integralClosure B F is Dedekind of dimension one and that Spec(C) → Spec(B) has finite fibres. By [lem-weil-pbc-integral-maximal-contracts-maximal], every maximal ideal of C contracts to a maximal ideal of B.

source.place: Algebra Lemma 09IG, applied with L = K, as invoked in Varieties Lemma 09N2

proof.text: Map a maximal ideal x of C to the pair consisting of its contracted maximal ideal y of B and its underlying prime ideal in the spectral fibre over y. This map is injective because the underlying prime ideal determines x. The sigma type of these fibres is finite: MaximalSpectrum B is finite and each spectral fibre is finite by [lem-sc-integral-closure-dedekind-surjective-fibres]. Thus MaximalSpectrum C is finite. The canonical B-algebra equivalence F ≃ K induces an equivalence integralClosure B F ≃ integralClosure B K. Pullback of ideals under this ring equivalence is injective and preserves maximality, giving semilocality for integralClosure B K. Noetherianity, dimension at most one, integral closedness and Krull dimension transfer under the same equivalence, giving the Dedekind and dimension-one conclusions.

source.place: Varieties Lemma 09N2 proof, first sentence after the invocation of Algebra Lemma 09IG

proof.text: Apply Mathlib integralClosure.isFractionRing_of_finite_extension with fraction field and extension field both K. The identity extension is finite dimensional, so K is the fraction field of integralClosure B K. This formalizes the inclusions B ⊆ integralClosure B K ⊆ K and the denominator argument of the source.
